_plotlines_comment: Curated 故事線, appended to the wiki's 故事系列 index by build-data.mjs. The wiki models story lines as relationship pairs, so add one here only for an arc that belongs to a single character or a cast the pairs cannot express. `episodes` is numbers only — titles are read back out of the episode list. `characters` are canonical roster names; a line shows up on each of their character pages.

plotlines.name: 黑化Terry線
plotlines.summary: 龍力蓮以「垂蓮聽政」操控龍力王談生意，力王自恨蠢鈍而轉向中醫館求變聰明；針灸意外刺激了腦內水瘤，他智力暴增並性情大變：架空力蓮、逼使余愛詩與Peter歸順大房、將吳家聰降職，更為與二房爭繼承人之位而盤算政治婚姻。直至頭痛揭出水瘤危及性命，才被力蓮、家聰強行送院手術打回原形，其後逐一贖回黑化期間的所作所為。

_featured_comment: Curated entry points for the home page's 精選 row, in display order. `kind` picks which catalogue `ref` is resolved against — plotline/character by name, tag by label. build-data.mjs warns on anything that no longer resolves (a renamed plot line, a dropped tag) rather than shipping a dead card.
